entities.name: Query IL-4 protein
observations: 138 aa secreted cytokine-like protein sequence with an N-terminal signal peptide-like hydrophobic segment.
Contains a Pfam IL4 domain (PF00727.24) spanning residues 28–134.
Strong homology to reviewed interleukin-4 proteins: 71.3–74.3% identity over 97.8% query coverage; best E-values 4.61e-60 to 6.86e-62.
Predicted molecular weight is 15.49 kDa and theoretical pI is 9.78; sequence has a net positive charge estimate at pH 7.
Likely extracellular after signal-peptide-mediated secretion; exact species and mature-chain processing are not established from sequence alone.

entities.name: Interleukin-4
observations: Reviewed homolog annotations describe cytokine and growth-factor activity with interleukin-4 receptor binding.

Interleukin-4 signaling is associated with JAK-STAT receptor signaling, immune-response regulation, B-cell activation, IgE and IgG1 responses, macrophage activation, and dendritic-cell differentiation.
Homolog annotations place IL-4 in the extracellular region and at the interleukin-4 receptor complex.

entities.name: IL-4 signaling
observations: Reviewed IL-4 homologs are annotated with interleukin-4-mediated signaling and JAK-STAT signaling through the IL-4 receptor complex.
